ExampleDefinition.Description:
This example demonstrates how to create a Histogram with Labels on columns in SciChart. This is achieved by combining the [url='https://www.scichart.com/documentation/win/current/The%20Column%20Series%20Type.html']FastColumnRenderableSeries[/url] with the built in Data Labels API.
Setting ShowDataLabels on the column series tells its DataLabelProvider to draw a value label above each column. The label font, size, weight and color are configured directly on the series, so no annotations are required.
